content.label: Examiner note - read the burette like the book says
content.body: Burette numbers increase top to bottom: 0 at the top, 50 at the bottom. Record to the nearest 0.05 cm3 - two decimal places, the second being a 0 or a 5. The titre is final reading minus initial reading; subtract before you round, and quote every reading to 2 dp or the mark scheme bites.
